EN: A {PREGNANT DWELLER} is ready to give birth! {TAP} the {ICON} above her head to welcome a {CHILD} to your Vault.
ZH: {怀孕的居民}已经准备好生产了！{点击}她头上的{图标}来欢迎避难所的{新成员}。

EN: A {PREGNANT DWELLER} is ready to give birth! {CLICK} the {ICON} above her head to welcome a {CHILD} to your Vault.
ZH: {怀孕的居民}已经准备好生产了！{点击}她头上的{图标}来欢迎避难所的{新成员}。

EN: Your {INVENTORY} is {FULL}. Excess {ITEMS} will be stored but {UNAVAILABLE} until there's space for them.
ZH: 您的{库存已满}。多出的{物品}将会保留，但无法使用，直到有足够的空间。

EN: {ITEMS} within a {DASHED RECTANGLE} exceed your {INVENTORY} and are {UNAVAILABLE} until there's space for them.
ZH: {虚线矩形边框}内的{物品}超出了您的{库存}容量，在有足够空间之前无法{使用}。

EN: {SCRAPPING} an {ITEM} turns it into {JUNK}, but it's {RISKY}. You might get lots of {JUNK}, just a little, or none at all.
ZH: {分解}一个{物品}来将其变成{杂物}，但此事有{风险}。您可能会得到很多{杂物}、一点点杂物，或者什么都得不到。

EN: Congratulations – you just built the {OVERSEER'S OFFICE}! You can now send teams of {DWELLERS} out of the Vault on {QUESTS}.
ZH: 恭喜！您刚建成了{监督者办公室}！您现在可以派出{居民}小队去避难所外执行{任务}了。

EN: When you are finished assigning and equipping {DWELLERS}, {TAP} the {START QUEST} button to send them out on their adventure.
ZH: 当您完成派遣和武装{居民}时，{点击}{开始任务}按钮就可以让他们出去探险了。

EN: When you are finished assigning and equipping {DWELLERS}, {CLICK} the {START QUEST} button to send them out on their adventure.
ZH: 当您完成派遣和武装{居民}时，{点击}{开始任务}按钮就可以让他们出去探险了。

EN: When you are finished assigning and equipping {DWELLERS}, select {START QUEST} to send them out on their adventure.
ZH: 当您完成派遣和武装{居民}时，选择{开始任务}按钮就可以让他们出去探险了。

EN: With {NUKA-COLA QUANTUM} you can reach a {QUEST} instantly. {TAP} here to use the {NUKA-COLA QUANTUM} Vault-Tec has provided to reach this {QUEST} now.
ZH: 用{量子核子可乐}，您可以立即到达{任务}地点。{点击}这里用避难所科技提供的{量子核子可乐}来极速到达{任务}现场。

EN: With {NUKA-COLA QUANTUM} you can reach a {QUEST} instantly. {CLICK} here to use the {NUKA-COLA QUANTUM} Vault-Tec has provided to reach this {QUEST} now.
ZH: 用{量子核子可乐}，您可以立即到达{任务}地点。{点击}这里用避难所科技提供的{量子核子可乐}来极速到达{任务}现场。

EN: With {NUKA-COLA QUANTUM} you can reach a {QUEST} instantly. Select {REACH NOW} to use the {NUKA-COLA QUANTUM} Vault-Tec has provided.
ZH: 用{量子核子可乐}，您可以立即到达{任务}地点。选择{现在到达}来使用避难所科技提供的{量子核子可乐}来极速到达现场。

EN: You can also use {NUKA-COLA QUANTUM} to skip {OBJECTIVES} in the {VAULT} and to speed up {CRAFTING}, {TRAINING} and Barbershop {CUSTOMIZATION}.
ZH: 您还能够使用{量子核子可乐}来跳过避难所里的每日{目标}，加速{打造}、{训练}和美发店{个性化}的进程。

EN: {QUESTS} allow you to explore new locations, meet new {DWELLERS} and collect {LOOT}. The {MAP ICON} in the upper right corner will display your {QUEST OBJECTIVES}.
ZH: {任务}能让您探索新的地点，认识新{居民}和收集{战利品}。右上角的{地图图标}会显示您的{任务目标}。

EN: If you don't want any new Dwellers, you can {STOP} the {RADIO STUDIO} from calling out. It will still broadcast in the Vault and boost {HAPPINESS}.
ZH: 如果不需要任何新居民，您可以{关闭}{广播站}的对外召唤功能，但其仍能在避难所内部播放广播，提升居民{幸福度}。

EN: To assign a {DWELLER}, {TAP} and {HOLD} on the Dweller and then {DRAG} them to a room. Try assigning this {DWELLER} to the {POWER GENERATOR} room you just built.
ZH: 要派遣一个{居民}，{点击}并{按住}居民，然后将他们{拖拽}到一个房间。试试将这个{居民}分配到您刚刚建好的{发电室}里。

EN: To assign a {DWELLER}, {CLICK} and {HOLD} on the Dweller and then {DRAG} them to a room. Try assigning this {DWELLER} to the {POWER GENERATOR} room you just built.
ZH: 要派遣一个{居民}，{点击}并{按住}居民，然后将他们{拖拽}到一个房间。试试将这个{居民}分配到您刚刚建好的{发电室}里。

EN: Use the {LEFT STICK} to {MOVE} the {DWELLER} to the {POWER ROOM} and press [A] to assign them to the room
ZH: 用左摇杆{移动}{居民}到{发电室}然后按下来分配他们。

EN: Use the {LEFT STICK} to {MOVE} the {DWELLER} to the {POWER ROOM} and press [A] to assign them to the room
ZH: 用左摇杆{移动}{居民}到{发电室}然后按下来分配他们。

EN: Use the {LEFT STICK} to {MOVE} the {DWELLER} to the {POWER ROOM} and press [A] to assign them to the room
ZH: 用左摇杆{移动}{居民}到{发电室}然后按下来分配他们。

EN: Each {SEASONAL DWELLER} will also unlock a new {QUEST LINE}. Unlock and build an {OVERSEER's OFFICE} to recruit your new Dweller!
ZH: 每个{赛季居民}都会解锁一条新的{任务线}。解锁并建造{监督者办公室}，来招募您的新居民！

EN: {SEASONAL DWELLERS} will arrive every few days. The {TIME} until the next {DWELLER} is shown in the top left.
ZH: {赛季居民}每隔几天到达一次。左上角的{时间}显示距离下一位{居民}抵达的倒计时。

EN: In addition to the timer, you may also need to complete other prerequisites to claim the {SEASONAL DWELLER}.
ZH: 除了等待倒计时，您可能还需要完成其他前置条件才能领取{赛季居民}。

EN: You just used the last available space for Dwellers in the Vault. Build more {LIVING QUARTERS} to accommodate more Dwellers.
ZH: 您刚刚用掉了避难所里最后的可用空间。建造更多的{宿舍}来安置更多的居民。

EN: The Scorched beat all your dwellers. But you'll get another chance... and Vault-Tec's improved medical systems have revived everyone for free!
ZH: 辐尸人打败了您所有的居民。但您还有机会……避难所科技的改良医疗系统已让所有人免费复活！

EN: You can start a {SCORCHED RAID} early if there is less than {12 HOURS} remaining. But make sure you're prepared!
ZH: 如果剩余时间不足{12小时}，您可以提前开始{辐尸人突袭}。但请确保自己已做好准备！

EN: {SCORCHED RAIDS} will occur every few days. The {TIME} until the next {RAID} is shown in the top left.
ZH: {辐尸人突袭}每隔几天发生一次。左上角的{时间}显示距离下一场{突袭}的倒计时。

EN: Gaining {RANKS} in the {SEASON PASS} gives you {REWARDS} that can be claimed in each of your Vaults.
ZH: 在{赛季通行证}中获取{等级}，即可获得可在每一座避难所领取的{奖励}。

EN: Complete {CHALLENGES} to earn progress on your {SEASON PASS}. New Challenges are unlocked each week.
ZH: 完成{挑战}来推进您的{赛季通行证}进度。每周都会解锁新的挑战。

EN: Welcome to {SEASONS}! You can now complete {CHALLENGES} rank up your {SEASON PASS} to earn rewards throughout the lifespan of this {EXPERIMENTAL VAULT}.
ZH: 欢迎来到{赛季}！现在您可以通过完成{挑战}来提升您的{赛季通行证}等级，从而在整个{实验避难所}的生命周期内获得丰厚奖励。

EN: Complete actions in your {EXPERIMENT VAULT} to earn {POINTS} and claim {REWARDS}. Challenge your {FRIENDS} to see who is the best {OVERSEER}!
ZH: 在您的{实验避难所}中完成行动来赢取{分数}并领取{奖励}。向您的{好友}发起挑战，看看谁才是最出色的{监督者}！

EN: Earn more {TOKENS} by logging in each day, watching video ads, and completing seasonal quests. The {PRIZES} change each day, so make sure to check back often for your next chance to win big!
ZH: 每天登录、观看视频广告并完成赛季任务，即可赚取更多{筹码}。{奖励}每天都会变化，请经常回来看看，抓住赢取大奖的下次机会！

EN: Earn more {TOKENS} by logging in each day, and completing seasonal quests. The {PRIZES} change each day, so make sure to check back often for your next chance to win big!
ZH: 每天登录并完成赛季任务，即可赚取更多{筹码}。{奖励}每天都会变化，请经常回来看看，抓住赢取大奖的下次机会！

EN: Earn more {TOKENS} by logging in each day, and completing seasonal quests. The {PRIZES} change each day, so make sure to check back often for your next chance to win big!
ZH: 每天登录并完成赛季任务，即可赚取更多{筹码}。{奖励}每天都会变化，请经常回来看看，抓住赢取大奖的下次机会！

EN: Throughout the season you will be able to test your luck on the {SPIN-TO-WIN WHEEL} and win {AMAZING PRIZES}!
ZH: 在整个赛季中，您都可以在{幸运转盘}上考验您的运气，赢取{超赞奖励}！

EN: {TAP} an {ULTRACITE WEAPON} from the list to craft it. You can unlock new recipes by upgrading the {ULTRACITE WEAPON FACTORY}.
ZH: {点击}列表中的一把{辐射极琉矿武器}来打造。升级{辐射极琉矿武器工坊}即可解锁更多配方。

EN: {CLICK} an {ULTRACITE WEAPON} from the list to craft it. You can unlock new recipes by upgrading the {ULTRACITE WEAPON FACTORY}.
ZH: {点击}列表中的一把{辐射极琉矿武器}来打造。升级{辐射极琉矿武器工坊}即可解锁更多配方。

EN: Use the {LEFT STICK} to {SELECT} an {ULTRACITE WEAPON} and {PRESS} [A] to craft it. You can unlock new recipes by upgrading the {ULTRACITE WEAPON FACTORY}.
ZH: 用{左摇杆}{选择}一把{辐射极琉矿武器}，然后{按下}来打造。升级{辐射极琉矿武器工坊}即可解锁更多配方。

EN: Time to fight back against those {SCORCHED}! Now that we have some {ULTRACITE}, let's use it to craft some powerful new {WEAPONS}.
ZH: 是时候反击那些{辐尸人}了！既然我们已经有了{辐射极琉矿}，就用它来打造几件强力的新{武器}吧。

EN: Sometimes these humans feel like characters in a video game. Incapable of doing anything on their own...
ZH: 有时候，这些人类感觉就像视频游戏里的角色，无法独立完成任何事情……

EN: They say there are 10 different kinds of people in the world. Those who understand binary... and those who don't.
ZH: 他们说世界上有10种人。懂二进制的和不懂二进制的。

EN: Personally, I think all this talk of an “Overseer” is so much rubbish. I've certainly never seen them.
ZH: 个人认为，关于“监督者”的所有说法都是胡说八道。我从来没有见过他们。

EN: The lighting in here is horrible. If I had eyes, they'd be ruined. Though I'd probably look dashing in horn rims...
ZH: 这里的灯光太差了。如果我有眼睛，它们早就废了。不过戴上眼镜，我可能会很帅……

EN: Of course. Send the domestic servant into a deadly post-apocalyptic Wasteland. What could possibly go wrong?
ZH: 当然。派个家务佣人去致命的末世废土。还能出什么岔子呢？

EN: Is that? Why yes, it's an old General Atomics factory. Looks like they broke the mold when they made me. Literally.
ZH: 那是？没错，那是个破败的通用原子工厂。看来他们造完我之后就把模具给砸了。这可是字面意思。

EN: You know, it's not much to look at, but an enterprising robot could make quite the life for himself out here...
ZH: 这地方看着是不怎么样，但一个有进取心的机器人在废土上也能闯出好日子来……

EN: My thermometer is reading the current temperature as something approaching “Seventh Circle of Hell”.
ZH: 我的温度计显示当前温度接近“地狱第七层”。

EN: Sensors indicate... Yes. That's a Super Mutant. And yes, I am now headed in the opposite direction...
ZH: 探测器显示……没错，那是个超级变种人。而且没错，我现在正朝反方向走……

EN: And to think, humans worried that robots would turn against them. They turned against themselves just fine...
ZH: 想想看，人类还担心机器人会反叛他们呢。他们自己反目成仇，倒是干得挺漂亮的……

EN: I think I'm getting... custodial withdrawal. I may have to enter one of these old homes and sweep up for a bit.
ZH: 我觉得我得了……清洁戒断反应。看来得进哪栋旧房子扫上一小会儿才行。

EN: A domestic robot dedicated to cleaning. Wandering a post-apocalyptic landscape. My OCD is going HAYWIRE.
ZH: 一个致力于清洁的家务机器人，在末世废土中游荡。我的强迫症要发作了。

EN: No. NO! Shoo, dog! Shoo! I am NOT a fire hydrant! I am a Mister Handy model... Agghh! No! BAD doggie!
ZH: 不。不！走开，狗狗！走开！我不是消防栓！我是巧手先生……啊！不！坏狗！

EN: This exploring is exhausting work. If I had pores, I'd be sweating like a corpulent human in a sauna.
ZH: 探索真是累人的活儿，如果我有毛孔，现在一定像桑拿房里的胖子一样汗如雨下。

EN: If I were a human, I'd be exceptionally thirsty right now. Guess that explains their Nuka-Cola obsession.
ZH: 如果我是人类，我现在一定会非常渴。看来他们对核子可乐的痴迷也不是没有原因的。

EN: I've heard rumors that a rogue A.I. actually caused the Great War. To think – WANTING a mess like this.
ZH: 我听说大战是由一个反叛的人工智能引发的。真是怪了——它怎么会想要把一切弄得这么混乱？

EN: Congratulations, you found the Mysterious Stranger and he's got some caps for you (you're virtually robbing him, basically).
ZH: 恭喜你找到了神秘陌生人，他给你带来了一些瓶盖（基本上你就是在“抢劫”他）。

EN: Vault-Tec has identified Novac as a strategic location for advancing our interests across the Mojave region. Recruit loyal allies, bring Novac under control, and transform it into a shining beacon beneath the dazzling glow of New Vegas! We're betting on you, Overseer!
ZH: 避难所科技已将诺瓦克认定为推进我们在莫哈维地区利益的战略要地。招募忠诚盟友，将诺瓦克收入麾下，并在新维加斯璀璨霓虹的映照下将其打造成一座闪耀的灯塔！我们押注你，监督者！

EN: Test your skill as Overseer in this season's new Experimental Vault! Experimental Vaults introduce a new twist and unique rewards. Seasons only last a short time - don't miss out!
ZH: 在本赛季新实验避难所中考验您作为监督者的实力！实验避难所引入全新玩法和独家奖励。赛季时间有限——千万别错过！

EN: New Vegas requires your attention, Overseer. Construct a new Vault to safeguard and support Vault-Tec allies in the region. Enlist key personnel, neutralize all hostiles, and let New Vegas' beacons blaze across the wasteland! May Lady Luck smile upon you!
ZH: 新维加斯需要你的关注，监督者。建造一座新避难所，以保护并支持避难所科技在该地区的盟友。招募关键人员，消灭所有敌对势力，让新维加斯的灯塔照亮整片废土！愿幸运女神对你微笑！

EN: Test your skill as Overseer in this season's new Experimental Vault! Experimental Vaults introduce a new twist and unique rewards. Seasons only last a short time - don't miss out!
ZH: 在本赛季新实验避难所中考验您作为监督者的实力！实验避难所引入全新玩法和独家奖励。赛季时间有限——千万别错过！
